title: Exact revelation accounting under deterministic resource coarse-graining
hypotheses: finite probability distributions p and q
deterministic resource coarse-graining represented by a partition of fine outcomes
operational distinction measured by total variation
theorem: TV(p,q)-TV(Kp,Kq)=sum_j min(P_j,N_j), where P_j and N_j are the positive and negative masses of p-q inside coarse cell j
equality_condition: TV(Kp,Kq)=TV(p,q) iff every coarse cell is sign-pure with respect to p-q, ignoring zero entries
prior_art_boundary: Underlying identity is standard total-variation/Jordan signed-measure mathematics. No historical novelty claimed.
surviving_PDT_claim: With an explicitly declared fine reference partition, accessible distinction plus unresolved within-cell likelihood-contrast cancellation equals fine distinction. This is an accounting identity, not a new physical conservation substance.
open_next: extend accounting to genuinely stochastic resource kernels with non-circular hidden variables
derive a PDT-native physical principle fixing the admissible resource map
seek a falsifiable consequence not already implied by standard statistical decision theory
